title: Recruited by the American Orthodox Catholic Church outside the funeral

tellings.quote: because on our way out, we bump into guys from the American Orthodox Catholic Church,

plain: An author named Peter Levenda says that around 1968, leaving a funeral in New York, he and a companion bumped into men from the American Orthodox Catholic Church, a small independent church, who drew him into their circle. Levenda tells it as his own experience, the chance meeting that started his path into fringe religious groups.
